text:
Lena M.: Heads-up: ApexFin (finance mid-market) has a renewal in ~5.5 weeks and we just noticed a sharp drop in production calls after their ML lead left last Friday. Procurement mentioned a MosaicAI bench test. Want a quick triage and playbook. :spiral_notepad:
Ravi S.: Oof. Do we have route-level diffs? Any errors or auth issues?
Lena M.: Quick console clip:
`30d active keys: 1,050 -> 340 (-68%)`
`Top impacted: /chat-complete (-66%), /bulk-embed (-59%)`
`Errors: steady 0.5%`
`p95 latency: 290ms`
Lena M.: Their champion (head of analytics) is still positive but paused while a new PM ramps. Procurement asked for a short reliability & cost note.
Tom Becker: Sounds like org churn + procurement noise. Proposed short plan: 1) health call w/ champion + new PM, 2) competitor snapshot vs MosaicAI, 3) quick cost/perf experiment on top prompts, 4) targeted enablement for new PM.
Marta - CS Lead: Assign owners and timelines. Keep everything <=72h except the exec touch.
Lena M.: I'll schedule the health call for tomorrow morning and request their top 15 prompts + a small eval rubric.
Ravi S.: I'll run the perf & quantization experiment against their prompt set once they share. Expect initial artifacts in 48-72h. Need sample prompts and any golden responses to compare.
eng-bot: Ticket INF-2247 created: "ApexFin - quant & perf bakeoff" assigned to Ravi S., due in 3 business days.
Ellen (Sales): If procurement is sniffing MosaicAI, we should also prepare a short commercial counter: 1mo extension + performance review offer. Loop RevOps once we have numbers.
RevOps Bot: Noted. Tagging: @Ellen for approval path. Provide ARR delta when you propose concession.
Tom Becker: Nate-style competitor one-pager would be useful: cost per token, latency profiles, embeddings parity, SDK/infra migration friction. Marta can own message framing.
Marta - CS Lead: I'll draft the messaging and suggested talking points for the champion to share internally. Keep it <1 page.
Lena M.: Action list (owners & due dates):
- Request prompts + confirm champion/new PM availability (Lena) - due EOD today
- Competitor snapshot vs MosaicAI (Tom) - draft in 48h
- Quant + batching perf run & artifacts (Ravi via INF-2247) - initial in 72h
- Enablement session (45m) for new PM + engineers (Marta) - schedule within 5 business days
- Short commercial proposal options (Ellen + RevOps) - draft in 48h
Tom Becker: I'll include a short migration checklist: embeddings swap steps, SDK changes, and estimated engineer-days.
Ravi S.: If quant + batching shows a ~30% cost reduction with <5% quality delta, that will be our strongest retention argument. I'll include diff examples.
Ellen (Sales): Perfect. I can do a 10-min exec nudge with their VP of Engineering before renewal if Marta or Lena want me on the line.
Marta - CS Lead: Please CC me on the health call invite. Lena, paste any procurement timelines here after the call.
Lena M.: Will do. Health call scheduled for tomorrow 9am PT. Sending calendar invite now.
Ravi S.: Posting results and configs to INF-2247 when ready.
Tom Becker: One-pager draft will be uploaded to the shared folder and linked here when ready.
Lena M.: Thanks all 64f. We'll reconvene after the health call and update last_message_ts with results.
